name: SIEGEWORKS | Java and Bedrock
description:
Siegeworks is semi-anarchy survival where your base is safe most of the time, until it isn't.

Claim land for chunk by chunk, fully protected. Then windows open on a fixed schedule:

- Raid nights, Monday to Thursday, 6 to 7 pm US Central. Claimed blocks can be broken and chests looted. Vaults are safe.

- Sieges, Friday to Sunday, 6 to 8 pm US Central. Everything a raid allows, and vaults can be taken.

Breaking in takes more effort. All mining times are nerf'd during raids, so obsidian barely helps and enchantments do nothing. Each claim keeps its loot in one vault. To take it, two attackers have to hold ground nearby for 10 minutes, then spend the time breaking in and defenders can stop the clock by defending against them.

The larger your claim, the more upkeep you pay to protect it your vault. If you miss a payment your vault can be broken at any moment until you pay.

No totems, no elytra, reduced mace and crystal damage, and no combat logging.

- Java 1.21.11 and Bedrock crossplay

- Local chat, plus proximity voice chat (Simple Voice Chat mod)

- Terralith terrain and Distant Horizons Server-side support

- Xray Protection

- Discord Alters when your base is raided while you're offline
